subtitle: Learn how delay effects create space, rhythmic complexity, and atmospheric textures in songs.

introduction.title: Delay: Time as a Musical Element
introduction.text: Delay effects repeat your signal after a specified time interval, creating everything from subtle thickening to complex rhythmic patterns. The timing of delay repeats can either reinforce the song's rhythm or create counter-rhythms for complexity.

columns.title: Temporal Effects
columns.text: The timing of delay repeats can either reinforce the song's rhythm or create counter-rhythms for complexity

columns.title: Musical vs. Atmospheric
columns.text: Musical timing enhances rhythm; non-musical timing creates texture and atmosphere

cards.description: 60,000 ÷ BPM = quarter note in milliseconds. Then divide or multiply for different subdivisions.

cards.title: Delay Time

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Time between original signal and repeat

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Determines rhythmic relationship to the song

items: Match to song tempo for musical timing, or use non-musical timing for texture

cards.title: Feedback/Repeats

fields.label: Description
fields.value: How many times the delay repeats

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Controls how long the delay tail lasts

items: Low settings for subtle enhancement, high settings for ambient washes

cards.title: Mix/Level

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Balance between dry and delayed signal

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: How prominent the delay effect is

items: Start low and increase until you hear the effect clearly, then back off slightly

cards.title: Modulation

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Slight variation in delay time

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Adds movement and prevents static repeats

items: Subtle amounts add life, too much creates chorus-like warbling

cards.title: Self-Oscillation
cards.description: Turn feedback up until delay begins to self-oscillate, creating infinite repeats and pitch changes.
items: Great for psychedelic effects and ambient textures

cards.title: Delay Throws
cards.description: Kick delay in and out rhythmically using the pedal switch to create specific effect moments.
items: Adds dramatic emphasis to specific notes or phrases

cards.title: Reverse Delay
cards.description: Some delays can reverse the delayed signal, creating backwards echo effects.
items: Creates mysterious, otherworldly textures

cards.title: Syncopated Timing
cards.description: Dotted eighth delays create syncopation against straight rhythms, adding rhythmic complexity without playing complex parts.
items: The Edge's signature sound relies heavily on this concept

cards.title: Polyrhythmic Effects
cards.description: Multiple delay taps at different timing subdivisions can create polyrhythmic textures from simple input.
items: Useful for progressive rock and experimental music

cards.title: Call and Response
cards.description: Use delay to create musical conversations between your playing and the delayed repeats.
items: Play phrases that complement their own delay

cards.title: Tempo Changes
cards.description: Fixed delay times create interesting effects when tempo changes within a song.
items: Can create tension or release depending on context

cards.title: Lead Guitar
cards.description: Quarter or eighth note delays add sustain and power to single-note lines.
items: Settings: 250-500ms, low feedback, moderate mix

cards.title: Ambient Pads
cards.description: Long delays with high feedback create expansive, atmospheric textures.
items: Settings: 800ms+, high feedback, high mix

cards.title: Rhythmic Enhancement
cards.description: Musical timing enhances rhythm parts without additional playing.
items: Settings: Tempo-synced, single repeat, low mix

cards.title: Slapback Thickening
cards.description: Very short delays thicken sound without obvious repetition.
items: Settings: 80-120ms, single repeat, low mix
